title: Callvale before: one root key
claim: One root access key in the code and on three laptops opens the whole account.
alt: Before: one EC2 instance runs Callvale's application, which calls Amazon S3 and Amazon Transcribe with the root user's access key. The same key is stored on three laptops. Ana and Ben share the root user's password.

edges.label: root key
edges.say: The application signs its calls to Amazon S3 and Amazon Transcribe with the root user's access key.

edges.label: in the code
edges.say: The same access key is stored in the code and on three laptops.

edges.label: shared password
edges.say: Ana and Ben sign in as the root user with one shared password.
